ops.body: The same irreducible re-read→write TOCTOU also surfaces in the hostsync MATERIALIZE path (installEnvelope, internal/hostsync/materialize.go): after re-proving both credential backends empty at write time, an external claude/ccp-add login can still write an owned credential in the microsecond window before the envelope write. Codex Phase-2 finding #6. Tightened to the same irreducible window as writeCredCAS; closed only by the shared-.oauth_refresh.lock work this task tracks. NOTE: the keychain-ErrUnavailable→file-fallback on this path is CORRECT (headless machines have no keychain creds to hide) and re-proves the file store empty — do not 'fail closed' there and break TestMaterializeKeychainUnavailableFallsBackToFile.
